facts.summary: Priced $8M offering with warrants at $0.12, well below $0.1728 prior close · Phase 3 · TMB-001 in congenital ichthyosis · not yet approved

evidence.summary: We are offering 46,583,333 shares of common stock, together with common warrants to purchase an equal number of shares of common stock at a combined public offering price of $0.12 per share
